summary: Fictional teaching implementation of the public example capability; never a production provider. Explicit Income contributes signed non-credit income; Transfer and Opening Balance entries are excluded from ordinary income and spending, and all ledger rows remain available in exports.

snapshot.description: Host-provided immutable BudgetSnapshot, including CategorySnapshot.kind (expense, income, transfer, opening_balance). Technical categories have zero envelope values.
